title: 대시보드 ‘검토 필요’ 34건의 분류 점검
blockedReason: Native 실행 요약이며 업무 수용·독립 검토는 별도입니다.

commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg --files src | rg -i 'dashboard|kanban|work-list|work-board'; rg -n '검토' docs/specs | rg -i '대시보드|칸반|카드' | head -25"
/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && git status --short --branch | head -12 && rg -n '검토 대기|검토 필요|검토 중|검토할|reviewPending|in_review|needs_review' src | head -100"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,collections
counts=collections.Counter()
for f in sorted(Path('docs/work').glob('*/*/work.json')):
 d=json.loads(f.read_text()); s=d.get('status'); counts[s]+=1
 if s=='verifying':
  w=d.get('workflow') or {}
  print(json.dumps({'path':str(f.parent),'id':d.get('id'),'blocked':d.get('blockedReason'),'next':w.get('nextAction'),'criteria':[(c.get('id'),c.get('status'),c.get('required')) for c in d.get('criteria',[])],'workflow_keys':list(w)},ensure_ascii=False))
print(counts)
PY"
